name: Naaman (Son of Benjamin)
title: Benjamin's son and clan founder
summary: Naaman was a son of Benjamin and grandson of the patriarch Jacob (Israel). He is mentioned among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob's family. He is regarded as the founder of the Naamite clan within the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as a son of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Naaman is listed among the sons of Benjamin in the genealogy of Jacob's descendants who went down to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's family travels to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Naaman was one of the 70 people in Jacob's household who traveled down to Egypt during the famine, where Joseph already held a position of power.

keyEvents.title: The Naamite clan in the tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: In the census recorded in Numbers, the Naamite clan is mentioned as one of the clans descended from Benjamin through Naaman.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Benjamin's genealogy in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Naaman is listed in the detailed genealogy for the tribe of Benjamin in 1 Chronicles, as part of Benjamin's descendants.
